evidence.title: DF-MoE: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Multimodal Sparse Mixture-of-Experts

summary: Researchers introduced DF‑MoE, a deepfake detection system that combines visual, audio, and textual cues using a sparse mixture‑of‑experts architecture. The approach markedly improves detection accuracy across diverse datasets and media formats, addressing the adaptability challenges of existing detectors.
title: New Multimodal Sparse Mixture‑of‑Experts Model Boosts Generalizable Deepfake Detection
